— Who We Are

Building Businesses.
Creating Opportunities.

Magnus Group is a diversified group of companies across Education, Technology, Construction, Retail, Fashion & Innovation. Our 13 core ventures and 5 partner ventures serve more than 35,000 customers through 2500+ staff at 20+ locations worldwide.

Different sectors. Shared ambition.

From skill-based technical institutes to online learning, electronics, fashion, construction and supermarkets, The Magnus Group brings together purpose-built brands that share one promise: real skills, reliable service and lasting value.

"Diversified across Education, Technology, Construction, Retail, Fashion & Innovation."

Vision

To build a diverse and future-ready business ecosystem that creates lasting value for people and communities.

Mission

To build and operate businesses that create opportunities, develop talent, solve real-world needs and drive sustainable growth.

Values

Integrity. Innovation. Excellence. People. Growth.
